messages:
emma_finance: Incoming EUR transfer from Nordwell Biotech settled 2026-02-12 08:23 UTC but bank reference is truncated and there's no remittance info. Amount €13,420 — looks like invoice #2249 but need confirmation before we clear. Can ops pull MT103/intermediary trace?
liam_support: Can you paste the payment details you have (sender acct, value date, receiving bank ref)? I can ping the customer for a copy if needed. :eyes: 
sasha_ops: If you have the beneficiary statement we can ask the bank for the full MT103. If intermediary bank stripped the remittance, MT103 is usually where the original remittance is embedded.
nora_payments: Posting the SWIFT copy we got from the gateway. Note: some fields are truncated by the correspondent bank.
```
:20:TRN20260212001
:32A:260212EUR13420,
:50K:/DE0987654321
Nordwell Biotech GmbH
:59:/GB29NWBK60000011111111
Redwood Inference Ltd
:70:INV 2249 NW-INV-?
:71A:SHA
```
liam_support: Ok looks like `:70` (remittance) has `NW-INV-?` — truncated. Amount and beneficiary match invoice 2249 but we need a full reference for audit. I recommend 1) open a trace with our bank to request full ordering info, 2) ask Nordwell to re-send remittance email/PO.
emma_finance: Agreed. Please create the bank trace and tag it PMT-4021 so AR knows to hold off dunning. Also add a note that the amount matches invoice 2249 but reference is ambiguous.
payments_bot: Created trace ticket PMT-4021. Bank trace requested to be sent to correspondent bank. ETA 24-48h.
sasha_ops: Filing the SWIFT trace now — I'll include the full MT103 request and highlight the `/REM/` and `:70:` fields. Will also ask treasury to check for any intermediary remittance fields.
liam_support: I'll reach out to the Nordwell AP contact (elaine@nordwell.eu) with a quick ask: please forward payment confirmation or remittance for the payment made 12 Feb for €13,420 referencing invoice 2249. Suggested message below, feel free to copy.
---
liam_support (suggested customer message):
Hi Elaine — we see a EUR transfer settled to our account on 12 Feb for €13,420 which likely pays invoice #2249. Our bank receipt has a truncated reference `NW-INV-?`. Could you confirm the invoice or forward your payment remittance/PO? Thanks, Redwood finance (emma_finance).
---
emma_finance: Copying that. Also can we check if the customer used a corporate/payroll account vs. AP account — sometimes payments come from a different entity name which complicates auto-recon.
liam_support: Good point — asking them to include payer account number in reply.
sasha_ops: Update from treasury: intermediary bank might have stripped special characters; we asked them to search for matching trace using ordering institution + amount + value date. Will update PMT-4021 when we hear back.
emma_finance: If trace fails, next step for AR: either manual apply (with approval) using invoice notes + customer confirmation, or hold for proof-of-payment. Let's wait for bank response first.
payments_bot: PMT-4021 status set to "tracing". Assigned to sasha_ops and nora_payments.
liam_support: Pinged customer. I included their internal PO number field in the email request so they can cross-ref.
emma_finance: Thanks — please post any proof (screenshot of bank receipt, MT103 image) here when it arrives. Also flag if amount differs by bank charges. :white_check_mark:
liam_support: Noted. I'll also add a short reconciliation note to the invoice so the billing system doesn't auto-send reminder.
